caseNameFull: Renee M. ZINNI, et vir v. JACKSON WHITE, PC

opinions.text: Motions of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperisdenied. Petitioners allowed until November 4, 2014, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
